jobs.jobDescription:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

About the Role

As a Product Manager at Dataiku, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and business value for a targeted set of capabilities. Working under the direct guidance of the Senior Manager of Product Management, you will support the execution and rollout of a specific portfolio of pre-identified product features across two key areas:

  • Persona-Specific Features: Capabilities like Visual Graph, Visual Edit, and Visual GLM that extend Dataiku's reach to new user personas through targeted, driven use cases.
  • Dataiku Business Applications: Packaged, task-oriented, Dataiku-managed applications designed for Business Experts. These applications provide consumer-grade, non-technical front ends while leveraging Dataiku’s underlying platform.

In this role, you will balance structured technical delivery with customer-facing feedback collection, ensuring that well-defined features are successfully built, tested, and launched.

Key Responsibilities

Market & Customer Feedback Coordination

  • Market vision overview: build a strong market vision and space understanding for your portfolio of products. Act as the primary expert for these.
  • Research: Conduct targeted market reviews, fact-finding, and customer insight exercises for your portfolio of products.
  • Feedback Collection: Run customer meetings to collect, document, and qualify user feedback.
  • Outreach Coordination: Assist in identifying and contacting relevant customers for structured outreach and feedback sessions.

Guided Product Scoping & Execution

  • Roadmap definition: Own the centralization of the product roadmap and priorities definition for your scope of products. Ensure you build the right consensus on priorities from all stakeholders incl. SVP Product and VP Engineering.
  • Feature Specification: Write clear user stories and functional requirements for pre-identified, simple product features, ensuring the development team understands immediate implementation goals.
  • UX Collaboration: Work closely with the UX/UI team to help map out wireframes and user flows based on existing product patterns and guidelines.
  • Development Support: Support the engineering and Technical Product Management (TPM) teams during development by explaining user stories and clarifying requirements.
  • Testing & Quality: Coordinate and execute basic test plans to validate features meet defined acceptance criteria before launch.

Launch Support & Tracking

  • Release Readiness: Own the delivery of all pre-launch materials, including feature documentation, release notes, and internal product demos.
  • Metric Tracking: Implement and track pre-defined KPIs and success metrics to monitor how new features perform post-launch.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 3 to 5 years in Product Management or as a Product Owner within an agile software development environment.
  • Core PM Skills: Proven foundational knowledge of the product management lifecycle, including a strong baseline ability to write clear user stories, define acceptance criteria, and manage a tactical backlog from day one.
  • Technical Requirements: Experience working with data tools, analytics platforms, or data science use cases. You must possess a solid understanding of data workflows and data science concepts to effectively communicate with our technical teams and users. Direct experience or familiarity with LLMs/GenAI, AI Agents, or building/managing plugin and extension ecosystems is a strong plus.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Strong organizational and communication skills, with a collaborative mindset that adapts well to international, cross-cultural team environments.
  • Growth Mindset: An eagerness to dive deep into new technical or business domains, actively seeking and applying feedback to grow as a product professional.

#LI-Hybrid #LI-FR1

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.

jobs.jobDescription:
What is the job?

Build the Future of Medical Cannabis in Poland

This is a genuine founder-style role. You will be Montu's first person on the ground in Poland, with a mandate to build the business from zero: the legal entity, the licences, the supply chain, the clinical model, and eventually the team.

You'll own the market-entry strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution. In the early stages, you'll wear multiple hats - meeting with regulators and healthcare providers, negotiating commercial partnerships, solving operational challenges, and ensuring patients can access life-changing treatment. As the business grows, you'll build and lead a high-performing local team, creating the foundations for long-term success.

Working closely with our global leadership team, you'll bring together clinical operations, patient experience, regulatory affairs, tech, logistics & supply chain, finance and product to build a scalable, compliant business in a highly regulated healthcare environment. We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves building from scratch, and is equally comfortable defining strategy as they are making things happen. If you're entrepreneurial, hands-on, commercially astute, and excited by the opportunity to transform access to medical cannabis in Poland, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note on contract type: this role will start on a contract basis while we establish the Polish legal entity, with the intention to move to permanent employment once the entity is set up and operational.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead the end-to-end launch of Montu in Poland, including establishing a new Polish legal entity and working with the wider European teams for support

  • Own and manage daily operations for Montu Poland, ensuring effective execution across all functional areas as the business is built up

  • Develop and execute market entry and growth strategy to establish and scale the Polish business

  • Build and manage relationships with importers, wholesalers and suppliers of medical cannabis products in Poland

  • Navigate Polish regulatory and licensing requirements for the import, wholesale and distribution of cannabis-based medicines

  • Develop and negotiate the local supply chain, including distribution and logistics partners

  • Scope and, where relevant, help establish clinical partnerships or a clinic model to support patient access

  • Identify, develop and execute new commercial opportunities and strategic partnerships

  • Build and implement operational processes and SOPs across key areas including patient onboarding, logistics, clinical operations, and compliance

  • Recruit, train and develop a high-performing local team as the business grows

  • Collaborate closely with central UK/EU functions (Regulatory, Product, Commercial, Finance, and Partnerships) to ensure alignment and operational excellence

  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational and commercial success

  • Represent Montu with local regulators, government bodies, industry associations and healthcare stakeholders

What do you need?

  • A genuine entrepreneurial mindset - energised by building something from zero, without an existing team or in-market infrastructure to lean on

  • Strong track record of leading small-to-medium teams and building operational structures from scratch

  • Experience owning or working closely with P&L responsibility

  • Experience navigating Polish regulatory and licensing requirements within a regulated sector (pharmaceuticals, medical devices, healthcare, or cannabis)

  • Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on, execution-focused mindset

  • Fluent Polish and strong professional English, written and spoken

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, including with regulators, government bodies and senior internal/external partners

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-changing environments, working autonomously while reporting into a remote, international leadership team

  • Willingness to travel across Poland as the business requires

  • Must be fluent in both Polish and English

Nice to have:

  • Experience within the Polish cannabis sector - ideally including import, wholesale or distribution of cannabis-based products

  • Established relationships with suppliers, importers and wholesalers in the Polish cannabis or pharmaceutical market

  • Experience setting up or scaling a legal entity or business operation in Poland

  • Experience establishing or operating a clinic or patient-facing healthcare service

About Us

Montu is a leading international medical cannabis company with operations across Europe and Asia-Pacific, working to make cannabis therapy accessible, reliable and properly integrated into modern healthcare. In the UK, Montu UK runs an end-to-end patient ecosystem covering pharmacy, prescription and care. In Germany, Montu's Alternaleaf platform connects patients with German-licensed doctors for consultation, prescription and pharmacy delivery, entirely online. Poland is the next market in that expansion, and this role leads it.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is seeking a Lead, Product Management to help shape and scale one of our core product areas as Carrot's platform continues to grow. In this role, you'll operate as a strategic driver within the Product organization — owning a significant portion of the product roadmap, setting direction for cross-functional initiatives, and raising the bar for product craft across the team.

This is a highly visible, high-impact role for someone who has already demonstrated strong product judgment and is ready to take on greater scope: shaping strategy, mentoring other product managers, and partnering directly with senior leadership on the initiatives that matter most to our members and business.

If you're energized by solving ambiguous, high-stakes problems and want to help define how Carrot builds products at scale, this role is for you!

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for a key product area, translating company priorities into a clear, prioritized plan of execution
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial partners around a shared vision and set of goals
  • Serve as a thought partner and informal mentor to other Product Managers, helping raise the bar on product process, discovery, and craft across the team
  • Make and communicate high-judgment prioritization decisions, balancing member experience, business impact, and technical feasibility
  • Partner directly with senior product and cross-functional leadership to shape quarterly and annual product strategy
  • Identify and address systemic gaps in process, tooling, or team practices that limit the Product team's effectiveness
  • Represent the Product team in executive and cross-functional forums, clearly communicating strategy, trade-offs, and outcomes

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Delivered a body of work that measurably improved member outcomes, engagement, or business performance within your product area
  • Built trusted, effective working relationships with cross-functional leaders across Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial/Customer Success
  • Established yourself as a go-to product thought leader, with other PMs seeking out your input on strategy and process
  • Shaped or improved a core product process (discovery, roadmapping, prioritization) that is now used more broadly across the team
  • Successfully led at least one significant, ambiguous, cross-functional initiative from concept through launch

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time at a fast-growing technology company; healthcare or digital health experience is a plus
  • A track record of owning complex, cross-functional product initiatives from strategy through execution
  • Strong product sense and the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints in your decision-making
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align both peers and senior leadership
  • Experience mentoring or informally guiding less-experienced product managers

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in fertility, family-building, or broader digital health benefits
  • Experience partnering with Clinical or Legal teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive products
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled product features or workflows
  • Experience operating in a fully distributed, remote-first organization

Why This Role Matters

As Carrot continues to scale, our Product team needs leaders who can operate with both strategic clarity and hands-on execution. This Lead, Product Management role is central to that effort — helping ensure our roadmap reflects the right priorities, our cross-functional partners are aligned, and our product practices scale sustainably as the team grows.

This is an opportunity to have an outsized impact: shaping not just a single product area, but the way Carrot's Product organization operates as it matures.

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes
  5. Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $168,000-$198,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.
